Code findings include saved reachability evidence as raw call-stack strings and explanation text. The call-stack array may combine frames from multiple paths; an empty array means no stack was captured, not that the finding is unreachable. get.summary: Get review comment metrics for merged pull requests
get.description: Returns JSON with one entry per merged pull request that has stored CodeRabbit review comment metrics. The inclusive UTC date window selects pull requests by merge date, regardless of when comments were posted. Pull requests without stored comments are excluded before pagination. Pagination is in write order rather than by merge date, so a pull request written after your cursor already passed its merge date (a backfill, or a reopen/reclose) still appears on a later page instead of being silently skipped. Each nested comment entry represents a stored finding; a comment URL may occur more than once when the posted comment contains multiple findings. Comment text is not returned. Unknown query parameters, including format and status, are rejected. Available on the Enterprise plan. Self-hosted CodeRabbit deployments can use this API when configured to send metrics to CodeRabbit Cloud. Requests include all organizations authorized by the API token unless narrowed by an organization selector.

ManageSeatsMembersRequest.title: Workspace key
ManageSeatsMembersRequest.description: Request to manage user seats with a workspace API key. Members are addressed by email or CodeRabbit user ID, and each entry declares its desired seat state.

members.description: Array of members to update. Each member is identified by `email` or `cr_user_id` (at least one required; `cr_user_id` takes precedence when both are provided).

items.description: One member to update. Identify the member by `email` or `cr_user_id` — at least one is required, and `cr_user_id` takes precedence when both are provided.

email.description: Email address of the member (unique per workspace). The only identifier that can enroll a member not yet known to CodeRabbit.

cr_user_id.description: CodeRabbit user ID of an existing member — the `user_id` returned by `GET /v1/users` when using a workspace key. Use it to address members who have no email. Never enrolls a new member: an unknown ID fails that entry with `USER_NOT_FOUND`.

seat_assigned.description: Desired seat state: `true` assigns a seat, `false` unassigns it. Omit to leave the member's seat unchanged.

identities.description: Declarative replacement of the member's full Git provider identity set. Omit to leave identities untouched; an empty array removes all identities.

provider.description: Git platform provider of this identity

self_hosted_instance_url.description: Host URL of the self-hosted instance this identity belongs to. Omit for cloud identities. The URL must match a self-hosted instance registered to the workspace.

org_id.description: Optional organization scope for self-hosted instance API keys. Set to `ALL` (case-insensitive) to apply the role change across every active organization on the self-hosted instance in one request. Set to a provider organization ID to target one organization on the self-hosted instance. Omit `org_id` to preserve the prior single-organization behavior. The `ALL` sentinel is valid only with self-hosted instance API keys; organization, workspace, and legacy keys cannot use it.

user_id.description: Unique identifier assigned by the Git provider

seat_assigned.description: Whether the user has a seat assigned

BulkOperationResponse.description: Response for bulk operations with partial success model

status.description: Operation status: 'success' if all succeeded, 'partial_success' if some succeeded, 'failure' if all failed

succeeded.description: Array of user IDs that were successfully processed

failed.description: Array of failures with error details

SeatAssignmentModeResponse.description: Seat assignment mode for the organization

mode.description: The current seat assignment mode. 'automatic' means new developers are auto-assigned seats when CodeRabbit is tagged; 'manual' requires admin approval.

UpdateSeatAssignmentModeRequest.description: Request to update the seat assignment mode

mode.description: The seat assignment mode to set. 'automatic' auto-assigns seats when CodeRabbit is tagged; 'manual' requires admin approval.

user_id.description: Identifier that failed: a provider user ID, or the supplied `cr_user_id`/`email` when the request used a workspace API key

description.description: Saved finding explanation as raw text.

reachability_call_stack.description: Stored human-readable reachability evidence captured for the finding. The array may combine and deduplicate frames from multiple paths, so it does not guarantee one source-to-sink order or a stable frame grammar. An empty array means no stack was captured; it does not mean the finding is unreachable.

SecuritySecretFinding.description: Secret metadata only. Secret values, matches, snippets, descriptions, and recommendations are never returned.

SecurityFindingProvenance.description: Optional scan provenance. Nested fields use camelCase. Linked repositories provide context; finding ownership and coverage remain with the primary repository. Paginated JSON does not load evidence: evidenceStatus is not_loaded, supportingContext is null, and sourceFrames is empty.

SecurityOrgId.name: org_id
SecurityOrgId.description: Git-provider organization ID for workspace API keys. Omit for the complete workspace scope.

SecurityRepoId.name: repo_id
SecurityRepoId.description: One exact Git-provider repository ID. It must belong to the authenticated organization scope; response items expose it as repository_id together with organization and repository names.

SecurityScanId.name: scan_id
SecurityScanId.description: Historical scan snapshot. By default each repository uses its latest completed scan.

SecurityCursor.name: cursor
SecurityCursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous JSON response.
